name: Delegation
description: A chat can ask another agent to work in its own chat and branch, then receive a short report when the sub-tasks finish.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: Start one sub-task in a separate chat and worktree. Commit work you need the child to see before calling this. The child keeps its own branch; merge it yourself after reviewing its work.

title.description: A short name for the sub-task

prompt.description: What the child agent should do

agent.description: The child agent id, such as claude or codex

project.description: Optional project key; defaults to this chat's project

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for your sub-tasks. This returns at once: end your turn after it says Waiting. A single message will bring their reports when they finish or one fails.

children.description: Child chat ids to wait for; defaults to unfinished children
